description: Redesign AcademicsPage.tsx, AdmissionPage.tsx, and HostelPage.tsx with cinematic glassmorphic UI.
steps: Rewrite src/pages/AcademicsPage.tsx: (a) Fixed background https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1497633762265-9d179a990aa6?w=1920&q=80 with dark overlay. (b) Standards 1-12 info, subjects, exam schedule in glass cards. (c) Staff directory in glass panels. (d) White headings, slate-300 body, emerald-400 accents. (e) Scroll animations. (f) Preserve all existing bilingual data and content.

Rewrite src/pages/AdmissionPage.tsx: (a) Fixed background https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1434030216411-0b793f4b4173?w=1920&q=80 with dark overlay. (b) Admission process steps in glass panels. (c) Eligibility and documents required in glass cards. (d) Keep the working application form but restyle it with glass inputs. (e) White/slate-300 text, emerald accents. (f) Preserve all existing bilingual data.

Rewrite src/pages/HostelPage.tsx: (a) Fixed background https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1555854877-bab0e564b8d5?w=1920&q=80 with dark overlay. (b) Hostel facilities, capacity, mess schedule, daily routine in glass cards. (c) Warden info in glass panels. (d) White/slate-300 text, emerald accents. (e) Preserve all existing bilingual data.
acceptance_criteria: AcademicsPage shows full-screen background with glass content panels
AdmissionPage has cinematic background with glassmorphic admission steps and working form
HostelPage has cinematic background with glass cards for facilities info
All three pages preserve bilingual t(en, mr) pattern and all existing content
